analysis.title: Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL): Q3'26 Earnings First Take
key_insights: GS expects an initial negative market reaction to Alphabet's Q3'26 report. Search & Other revenue missed GS/FactSet estimates, Google Services margin was lighter than expected, and Cloud revenue beat estimates but fell short of more bullish investor expectations.
Q3 consolidated gross revenue was $127.58bn, +25% YoY. That compares with GSe $127.49bn and Visible Alpha Street $127.75bn, so it was roughly in line.

Google Search & Other revenue was $63.35bn, +12% YoY, below GS/FactSet estimates. GS expects questions on search run-rate growth and on the effect of broader search across a wider set of AI canvases and queries.

Google Cloud revenue was $30.71bn, +103% YoY, above GS and Street estimates but short of more bullish investor expectations. Cloud operating income was $11.12bn, and Cloud margin outperformed GS expectations even after management flagged 2H headwinds on the last call.
Q3 GAAP operating income was $40.58bn, a 32% margin, against GSe $43.35bn and Street $43.41bn. Google Services margin was lighter than GS expected.
Q3 GAAP EPS was $2.12 against GSe $2.96 and Street $2.95. EPS and net income were affected by volatility in the value of equity holdings.
Q3 capex of $51.4bn was below GS's ~$60bn estimate.

GS expects the call to focus on four things: the drivers of Search & Other growth deceleration, Alphabet's positioning against a consumer agentic AI landscape, compute constraints (priorities, return profile and when they might ease), and capital allocation priorities across capital needs and capex.
GS keeps a Buy rating and a $435 12-month price target. The stock closed at $320.58 on 27 Oct 2026, 35.7% below the target.

market_movers.rationale: GS expects a negative initial reaction to Q3 because of the Search & Other miss and lighter Services margin. It keeps its Buy rating and $435 target, unchanged from 23-Jul-26.

earnings_insights: Q3 revenue reported 10/28: $127.58bn gross, +25% YoY, vs GS estimate $127.49bn and Visible Alpha Street estimate $127.75bn.

Q3 segment revenue reported 10/28: Google Search & Other $63.35bn (+12% YoY), YouTube Ads $11.21bn (+9%), Network $7.46bn (+1%), Google Cloud $30.71bn (+103%), Subscriptions, Platforms and Devices $14.29bn (+11%), Other Bets $372mm (+8%).
Q3 GAAP operating income reported 10/28: $40.58bn (32% margin) vs GS estimate $43.35bn and Street estimate $43.41bn. By segment: Google Services $39.16bn, Google Cloud $11.12bn, Other Bets $(2.05)bn.
Q3 GAAP EPS reported 10/28: $2.12 vs GS estimate $2.96 and Street estimate $2.95, affected by volatility in equity values the company holds.
Q3 capex reported at $51.4bn vs GS estimate of ~$60bn.
GS estimates 9/26E EPS at $2.96, 12/26E at $3.39 and 3/27E at $3.65. These are pre-print estimates and were not updated in this note.
risk_factors: Competition on product utility and ad dollars.
Headwinds to monetizable search from industry disruption.
Heavy investment depressing operating margins for longer than GS forecasts.
No or low incremental shareholder returns.
Regulatory scrutiny and industry practices altering the business model.
